headline: Membership erosion and a tougher cost trend squeeze margins
summary_short: Molina's FY2026 Q2 diluted EPS fell to $1.19 from $4.75 a year ago as total revenue slipped 4.8% y/y to $10,874M and the consolidated medical care ratio rose 180bp to 92.2%; sequentially, net income of $60M rebounded from Q1's impairment-depressed $14M.
summary_long: Premium revenue fell 6% y/y as membership dropped 14% to 4.9M (Medicaid market contraction, the Virginia contract's expiration, and Marketplace attrition), partly offset by rate updates. Consolidated MCR rose 180bp to 92.2%, pushing operating income down to $145M from $373M. The six-month total carries a $93M Q1 impairment tied to Molina's planned 2027 MAPD exit, which explains net income's q/q jump from Q1's impairment-depressed $14M to $60M. Cash fell to $4,985M from $5,314M at Q1-end; no buybacks were made in H1 2026. Guidance: Medicaid membership 4.5M, Medicare 230,000, Marketplace 250,000 by year-end 2026, plus a ~$1B FY2027 Marketplace premium decline as it re-prices toward target margins.
